data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 were GBP 262.391m. Analysis of the gross claims development table shows no material aggregate prior-year movement for underwriting years through 2016 (net movement across older years effectively nil), indicating a flat prior-year development at the 2018 year-end. The accounts note favourable settlements affecting 2015 and prior years (generating a GBP 9.4m pre-expense profit from the 2015 RITC) and also reference catastrophe activity in 2017 (Harvey, Irma, Maria) and 2018 (Florence, Michael, California wildfires), but these did not produce a material gross prior-year strengthening at the 2018 reporting date.
raw_causal_phrases: This arose largely from a reduction in the 2015 and prior years' liability reserves as a result of favourable settlements in 2018.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was derived from the gross claims development table (Gross triangle) which shows no material aggregate movement across underwriting years up to 2016. The report also contains several NET prior-year movement figures and narrative items (e.g. net movements by class and RITC profit of GBP 9.4m from 2015), but a gross movement note for prior years was not explicitly given; therefore the triangle was used as the primary gross source. Lob movements shown above are taken from the report's 'Significant movements' disclosure but those amounts are labelled as NET (the note header states 'net ultimate claims provisions'); accordingly lob_movements are net figures and have lower confidence.
